author: Inside Edition
description: At 83, American TV legend Judge Judy is not slowing down after stepping away from her show. She spent 30 years as America's favorite TV judge with "Judge Judy" and the Amazon Prime spinoff "Judy Justice." Now she is the executive producer of her son's new show "Adam's Law." On Wednesday, the icon celebrated the 10th anniversary of her mentorship program, "Her Honor Mentoring." Inside Edition was at the annual luncheon.
title: Judge Judy Celebrates 20th Anniversary Of Mentorship Program

author: Inside Edition
description: "I am Jane Doe" has become a rallying cry for many women joining in solidarity with the alleged rape victim at Cornell University. Although she supports the woman at Cornell University being called Jane Doe, one woman says "I am not Jane Doe." Shira Astrof has been public about what she says happened to her and wants people to know her name.  She says she was violently and sexually assaulted by a man she met through a dating app. Astrof appeared on the TV drama "911" and "The Office." She spoke with Inside Edition's Jim Moret.
title: Actor Says Not To Call Her Jane Doe

author: Inside Edition
description: A man charged with killing his wife fled to Italy earlier this year, authorities said. Italian officials have blocked his extradition to Texas to stand trial and are seeking assurances the man will not receive the death penalty, according to the man’s defense attorney. The parents of  Christa Gilley are speaking out and appealing to an Italian judge to extradite their son-in-law, Lee Gilley, who is accused of strangling Christa in their home two years ago. She was eight weeks pregnant with their third child. He has pleaded not guilty.
title: Man Fled To Italy After Allegedly Killing Wife, Her Parents Want Him Extradited

author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly woman delivered her own eulogy at her own funeral. Shelvy Neal, 80, decided she wanted to experience what her funeral would be like, and to hear what people would say about her. Her fear of missing out on her own funeral resulted in lots of hugs. Now she knows that when the time really comes, she will be dearly missed.
title: 80-Year-Old Woman Has Her Own Funeral To Combat 'FOMO'

author: Inside Edition
description: Bryan Seaver played a major role in his aunt Dolly Parton's life. She even hand-picked him to announce her passing, and he served as her head of security for two decades before being fired in August. Now there's major drama in front of Seaver's home, which has been barricaded with barbed wire and caution tape. The unusual scene has many wondering what's going on at the residence. Inside Edition's Megan Alexander is at Seaver's home outside Nashville with the latest.
title: Why Are There Barricades Outside Dolly Parton's Nephew's Home?

author: Inside Edition
description: Convicted murderer Christa Pike is reportedly conscious and speaking from her hospital bed after her failed execution last week in Tennessee. The death row inmate was scheduled to become the first Tennessee woman executed in more than 200 years. But after she survived  botched lethal-injection attempts, her fate is uncertain. Tennessee's governor has halted all executions pending an investigation into what went wrong.
title: Christa Pike Is Awake And Talking After Failed Execution

author: Inside Edition
description: A Maryland K9 and its handler are being credited with saving a boy's life Tuesday night in Prince George's County. Body cam video of patrol officers, missing persons unit detectives and members of the Special Operations Division’s K9 Section was released by the Prince George's County Police Department, and it shows officers searching for a missing child. The officers spent three hours combing the terrain looking for the child that had wandered away from home. The circumstances surrounding the boy's disappearance have not been made public.
title: Bodycam Footage Captures Police K9 Rescue of Lost Boy

author: Inside Edition
description: The former Army soldier who killed 13 other service members at Fort Hood in 2009 is scheduled to be executed by firing squad.  A Pentagon spokesman posted on X: "Secretary of War Pete Hegseth has recommended — and President Donald J. Trump has approved — death by U.S. Army firing squad for convicted terrorist Nidal Malik Hasan." Hasan, who is 56, has been on death row at Fort Leavenworth Federal Prison in Kansas since his conviction. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Fort Hood Mass Shooter Set To Die By Army Firing Squad In December

author: Inside Edition
description: Guns went off to honor the service of 16 veterans who were laid to rest in Iowa after their remains went unclaimed. A local church held a memorial ceremony, community members attended to pay respect, and then a helicopter brought them to a ceremony. The Final Salute is an organization that gives veterans who die without family or recognition get the dignified burial, with full honors, that they deserve. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Funeral Services Held For 16 Unclaimed Veterans In Iowa
